description: Multi-step pandas DataFrame pipeline in a single Dagster asset — the pandas-engine sibling to polars_pipeline.

inputs.description: Upstream DataFrame(s) — one or more, depending on shape; accepts pandas or polars

outputs.description: pandas DataFrame after the chain (last step / primary_step)

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Flat shape (one source, one ops chain, one sink)

operations.label: Operations
operations.description: Flat shape: ordered list of pandas ops applied to upstream_asset_key. Supported: filter, with_columns, select, drop, rename, group_by, sort, head/limit, tail, head_per_group, unique, drop_nulls, fill_null, cast, join, union, sql, pivot, lookup, window_calculation.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: Multi-step form. Each step: {id, source: {kind: upstream|ref|file|url|encrypted_file, ...}, operations: [...]}. Use 'op: sql' to drop into an in-memory DuckDB connection (current frame = 'self'; prior steps usable by id).

sinks.label: Sinks
sinks.description: Optional side-output writes. Each: {from: <step_id>, kind: parquet|csv|ndjson|table|encrypted_file, path/table: '...'}. `kind: ndjson` additionally takes `mode: overwrite|append` (append reads-concats-rewrites; single-writer, not concurrent-safe). These run after the chain finishes; the asset's return value comes from primary_step.

primary_step.label: Primary Step
primary_step.description: Step id whose frame is the asset's return value (default: last step)

source.label: Source
source.description: File / URL / encrypted-file source shape. `{kind: file, path, format?, delimiter?, has_header?, quote_char?, dtype_overrides?}` or `{kind: url, url, format?, delimiter?, has_header?, quote_char?, dtype_overrides?}` (CSV only: has_header default true, quote_char default '"', dtype_overrides: {column: pandas dtype name e.g. 'object'/'string'/'Int64'/'float64'} -- pins a column's type instead of letting pandas' own schema inference guess, e.g. a zero-padded code column like '001' silently becoming the integer 1) or `{kind: upstream_asset, upstream_asset_key}` or `{kind: encrypted_file, path, format?, has_header?, quote_char?, dtype_overrides?}` (see key_source/raw_key_env_var/kms_key_ids/key_id/encryption_context below). `path`/`url` support `{partition_key}` and `{partition.<name>}` templating. Format is inferred from extension (.json / .ndjson / .csv / .parquet) when unset. Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

key_source.label: Encryption Key Source
key_source.description: 'raw_key' (a user-supplied symmetric key via AWS ESDK's RawMasterKeyProvider) or 'kms' (an AWS KMS CMK via AWS ESDK's StrictAwsKmsMasterKeyProvider). Only used when a source or sink kind is 'encrypted_file'.

raw_key_env_var.label: Raw Key Env Var
raw_key_env_var.description: Env var holding a base64-encoded 256-bit (32-byte) symmetric key. Required when key_source='raw_key' and an encrypted_file source/sink is used.

kms_key_ids.label: KMS Key IDs
kms_key_ids.description: KMS key ARN(s) for StrictAwsKmsMasterKeyProvider. Required when key_source='kms'.

key_id.label: Key ID
key_id.description: Logical wrapping-key identifier for raw_key mode. Must match between the encrypt run and the decrypt run.

encryption_context.label: Encryption Context
encryption_context.description: Additional authenticated data (AAD) for the AWS Encryption SDK. Must match exactly between encrypt and decrypt.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (sample rows) for builder UIs.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when `include_preview_metadata` is True.

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'cron' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values; 'dynamic' for a DynamicPartitionsDefinition. Leave empty for unpartitioned. Use `partition_dimensions` instead for multi-dimensional partitioning.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts — e.g. a (bank, batch_day) shape. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

metadata.label: Metadata
metadata.description: Asset-level metadata dict — passed straight through to `@asset(metadata=...)`.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset).

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one run. 'multi_run' launches one run per partition. Leave empty for Dagster's default.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.
